parameters: harness: inflow into the v_in_sum Sum port (formerly its run value)

invariants.description: Poiseuille resistance and thin-wall compliance: R = 8 mu l/(pi r_0^4), C = 2 pi r_0^3 l/(E h), h = r_0(a e^(b r_0) + c e^(d r_0)) (Avolio wall-thickness fit)
exact solution with constant BCs: u(t) = u_ss + (u(0) - u_ss) e^(-t/RC), u_ss = u_out + R v_in_sum (= vin/v), u(0) = u_0 + u_ext (q_C(0) = 0)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(u - ((u_out + R*v_vin) + ((u_0 + u_ext) - ((u_out + R*v_vin)))*np.exp(-t/(R*C))))) <= 1e-6*(np.max(np.abs(u)) + 1.0) + 1e-4*abs(((u_out + R*v_vin)) - ((u_0 + u_ext)))

invariants.description: Poiseuille/Ohm law at the outlet: v = (u - u_out)/R
volume balance: q_C(t) = integral of (inflow - outflow) (trapezoid rule on the logged points)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_C - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(((v_vin - v))[1:] + ((v_vin - v))[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= (1e-3 + ((t[1] - t[0])/(R*C))**2/6)*np.max(np.abs(q_C)) + 1e-8*np.min(C)*np.max(np.abs(u))

invariants.description: total volume q = q_0 + q_C with unstressed volume q_0 = pi r_0^2 l
invariants.expr: np.allclose(q_0, np.pi*r_0**2*l, rtol=1e-9) & np.allclose(q, q_0 + q_C, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: u_C = q_C/C + u_ext and u = u_0 + u_C
invariants.expr: np.allclose(u_C, q_C/C + u_ext, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9) & np.allclose(u, u_0 + u_C, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-9)

bc_sweep.rationale: BCs span the reference pressure u_0 up to u_0 + 3 dp (dp = test pressure drop of the vessel class) and flows 0 to 3x the equilibrium flow dp/R; u_ext -1000..1000 Pa (tissue pressure); geometry, E, mu and the wall-thickness coefficients at 0.5-2x (the exact solution is re-evaluated at every point, so all invariants must hold across the whole region).

baseline.reason: candidate: williams1988dynamic human nailfold capillary pressures (arteriolar limb 37.7, apex 19.4, venular limb 14.6 mmHg, steady mean values): a pp/vp capillary between fixed arteriolar- and venular-limb pressures should give the apex pressure; not set up because a single steady value only checks (u_in + u_out)/2 and needs the owner to agree it is a meaningful baseline
